label: IKS|Lab listening room, Institute of Communication Systems, RWTH Aachen University
note: ITU-R BS.1116-3 room, T60 0.25 s or less (documentation.pdf); two Neumann KH120D about 60 degrees apart (sources left and right), KU100 about 1.7 m away, ears at about their height; the receiver is the KU100's head angle in degrees (-180 to 150, 30-degree steps; positive turns the head left), first of the two sweeps per angle; KU100 ears only: the B&K 4101-B microphones worn at the ears are in data.mat and left out on purpose; the quasi-continuous BRIRs need the authors' NLMS code and are not indexed. RIRDB measures T30 0.19 s at 500 Hz-1 kHz and 0.24 s broadband; the authors' T60 of about 0.25 s is the broadband average. rwth_em64 measures the same room at 0.18 s.
